title: My 3-Tool Stack for a lean week
caption:
Every week without your tools costs you hours

The old way vs. what actually works now:
1️⃣ Notion AI — your docs, wiki, and database with AI that answers questions across all of it
2️⃣ Metricool — one calendar to schedule and measure IG, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube
3️⃣ Gamma — generates a designed slide deck or one-pager from a prompt

Tag someone still doing it the old way.
